   e=np.r_[pos-self.k.xpos[self.c],R.from_matrix(rot@self.k.xmat[self.c].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()]

class Controller:
    def __init__(self, instance):
        self.s = rcb_dtb.Session(instance)
        self.m, self.d = self.s.model, self.s.data
        self.k = mujoco.MjData(self.m)  # Separate data for kinematics only.
        self.c = self.m.body("palmleft_hand_C_MC").id
        self.R0 = np.array([[0, 1, 0], [0, 0, -1], [-1, 0, 0.]])

    def ik(self, pos, rot, q=None):
        if q is None:
            q = self.s.targets.copy()
        q = q.copy()
        self.k.qpos[:] = self.d.qpos
        for _ in range(100):
            self.k.qpos[self.s._jq] = q
            mujoco.mj_forward(self.m, self.k)
            e = np.r_[pos-self.k.xpos[self.c],
                      R.from_matrix(rot@self.k.xmat[self.c].reshape(3, 3).T).as_rotvec()]
            if np.linalg.norm(e) < 1e-6:
                break
            jp = np.zeros((3, self.m.nv))
            jr = jp.copy()
            mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m, self.k, jp, jr, self.c)
            J = np.r_[jp[:, :7], jr[:, :7]]
            dq = J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5, e)
            q[:7] += dq*np.minimum(1, .1/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-9))
            q[:7] = np.clip(q[:7], self.s.lower[:7], self.s.upper[:7])
        return q

    def move(self, q, n):
        old = self.s.targets.copy()
        for a in np.linspace(0, 1, n):
            self.s.step(old+(q-old)*(3*a*a-2*a*a*a))

    def movep(self, p, n):
        self.move(self.ik(np.array(p), self.R0), n)

    def hold(self, n):
        for _ in range(n):
            self.s.step(self.s.targets)

    def pose_error(self, pos, rot):
        Rp = self.d.xmat[self.c].reshape(3, 3).copy()
        po = self.d.xpos[self.s._obj].copy()
        Ro = self.d.xmat[self.s._obj].reshape(3, 3).copy()
        pp = self.d.xpos[self.c].copy()
        ep = pos-po
        er = R.from_matrix(rot@Ro.T).as_rotvec()
        return Rp, po, pp, ep, er

    def servo(self, state, kp, kr, vmax, wmax, joint_step):
        Rp, po, pp, ep, er = state
        dp = ep*kp
        dr = er*kr
        dp *= min(1, vmax/(np.linalg.norm(dp)+1e-9))
        dr *= min(1, wmax/(np.linalg.norm(dr)+1e-9))
        dR = R.from_rotvec(dr).as_matrix()
        pt = po+dp+dR@(pp-po)
        Rt = dR@Rp
        q = self.ik(pt, Rt)
        q[:7] = np.clip(q[:7], self.s.targets[:7]-joint_step,
                       self.s.targets[:7]+joint_step)
        self.s.step(q)

    def follow(self, end, mode):
        last = -1
        while self.s.goal_index < end:
            if self.s.failed:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Goal timed out: {self.s.progress()}")
            g = np.array(self.s.goals[self.s.goal_index])
            Rgoal = R.from_quat(g[3:]).as_matrix()
            roll = R.from_quat(g[3:]).as_euler('xyz')[0]
            if mode == 'late':
                offset = .2
                g[0] -= .004
            else:
                offset = np.clip(1.05-roll, -.30, .30)
                if mode in ('clamp', 'gentle'):
                    if self.s.goal_index >= 19:
                        offset = 0.
                    g[0] = min(g[0], .203 if mode == 'gentle' else .2025)
            Rgoal = Rgoal@R.from_rotvec([offset, 0, 0]).as_matrix()
            state = self.pose_error(g[:3], Rgoal)
            if mode == 'slow':
                self.servo(state, .12, .10, .0007, .006, .015)
            elif mode == 'gentle':
                self.servo(state, .10, .08, .0005, .004, .01)
            else:
                self.servo(state, .25, .20, .0015, .012, .03)
            if self.s.goal_index != last:
                print(f"Reached {self.s.goal_index}/49 at step {self.s.steps}", flush=True)
                last = self.s.goal_index

    def tilt(self, second=False):
        po = self.d.xpos[self.s._obj].copy()
        Ro = self.d.xmat[self.s._obj].reshape(3, 3).copy()
        pos = po + ([-.025, 0, .03] if second else [0, 0, .05])
        rot = R.from_euler('y', 80, degrees=True).as_matrix()@Ro
        for _ in range(740 if second else 700):
            state = self.pose_error(pos, rot)
            ep, er = state[-2:]
            if second and np.linalg.norm(ep) < .002 and np.linalg.norm(er) < .02:
                break
            self.servo(state, .2, .15, .0015 if second else .001,
                       .015, .025 if second else .02)

    def slide(self, hand, delay):
        closed = self.s.targets.copy()
        loose = closed.copy()
        loose[7:] = hand
        self.move(loose, 10)
        self.hold(delay)
        self.move(closed, 7)
        self.hold(100)
